steps.content: When everyone rushes to the park, the battle is already over.

Shattered plants lie across the park and the land is covered in Corruptor remains. A pair of heels is keeping Garofano down. Her single-eyed rune burns constantly in vain, eventually dims and dies out.

At last, only Rahu stands at the center of the battlefield. The contamination all gathers and huddles around her. Her sword-shields are hefty and sharp, and her battle uniform is covered in blood stains.
The liaison officer's brow furrowed, and quickly turned to leave. Yet, he was stopped by someone.

Shalom halts the liaison officer, not uttering a word, just gazing intently at the nearly uncontrollable beast in the midst of the Blue Rain. After a moment, she moved forward alone, stepping into the ravaged garden.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Look what you did to this place... I liked this garden a lot.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Didn't I tell you to accomplish your mission and not look back no matter what?

The Blue Rain and contamination stir her senses alternately. They can't see Rahu's face. Her breathing sounds labored through the face mask. Though exhausted and repressed, she looks like a menacing ghost. Only one thought remains.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Is this all you've come back for?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You've failed your test, Rahu. You've sabotaged your own path. I'm disappointed in you.
